name: Altai osman and lake fish
desc: A cyprinid fish of Mongolia and Tuva; the Uvs Lake area has about 29 fish species in all, and the osman is the one eaten by people.
about: Oreoleuciscus potanini, the Altai osman, is a species of freshwater ray-finned fish belonging to the family Leuciscidae, which contains the daces, chubs, true minnows and related species.
